newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt says buys 69,000T palm, vegoils.
newsitem.headline: Egypt says buys 69,000T palm, vegoils.

text.p: Egypt's official Holding Company for Food Industries said on Wednesday it bought a total 69,000 tonnes of palm, sunflower and degummed soy oils at prices between $546.50 and $565 per tonne for delivery in April and May.
Moharram Ghanem, head of the firm's sales sector, told Reuters he had bought the oils in the following lots and prices (all C and F) -
-- 10,000 tonnes of palm oil from Felda at $565 for May delivery.
-- 25,000 tonnes of sunflower oil from Topefer at $548.25 for delivery in the first half of May.
-- 10,000 tonnes of sunflower oil from Cargill at $548.25 for delivery in the first half of May.
-- 3,000 tonnes of sunflower oil from Finagrain at $546.50 for delivery in the second half of April.
-- 15,000 tonnes of degummed soy oil from Finagrain at $547 for delivery in the first half of May.
-- 6,000 tonnes of degummed soy oil from Cargill at $547 for delivery in the first half of May.
The firm had originally tendered for 45,000 tonnes. --Miral Fahmy +202 578 3290/1
